anims_note: Inclusive column ranges within the facing row (idle and walk loop; attack plays once: crouch, lunge with open jaws, recover). Corpse is row 0 column 6 only (frame index 6), faces right (E); column 6 of rows 1-7 is transparent. Attack is in every row.
body_note: Frame-local px (top-left of the frame), from the idle frame-0 silhouette inset by the 1 art-px outline; use for click / hit tests. The origin stays at the frame bottom (base_y_px); standing feet sit on ground_line_px.
mirror: None: every row is its own rendering (light stays top-left in all 8 facings).
diagonals: SE / SW / NE / NW are rendered from the same 3D puppet as S / W / E / N (REMAKE-1 batch 4).
src_note: S, N, SE and NE are the wolf_adult generations scaled down to 44 / 43 / 44 / 43 px in code; E is its own juvenile generation.
gait: diagonal-pair trot: FL with HR, FR with HL. Walk 0: FL+HR planted forward, FR+HL planted back; 1: FL+HR under the body, FR+HL swing (body up 1 art px); 2 and 3 mirror 0 and 1. A planted paw moves back exactly 2.0 art px (4.0 px) per frame, so it never slides.
